facts.fact: The Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation presented Service-Wise GPT, an AI assistant for federal civil servants on civil-service rules and directives, in January 2025, then offered as a beta version.

systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation

facts.fact: A training programme developed by UNESCO, the University of Oxford and the Kenya School of Government saw 1,239 civil servants complete a first cohort of 2,730 learners, and a second cohort launched on 21 October 2026 aims to train 9,000 more officials in AI governance and digital transformation.
